change.what: size and tile_colors checks become report-only (gate: false); every candidate that passes the remaining gates (colors, orphans, outline) is judged
change.why: human feedback on v1 squid s1: the gates rejected the three best drafts (28-36 px, one tile with 4 colours) before the judge saw them, so the system picked the weakest; the human rated lock.3 (28x29) far and away the best. Image models draw at ~24-36 px, so size should be judged, not gated, until a step can shrink sprites.
